citation.verbatim: The Amendment became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on June 7, 2024. Exhibit 3.1: At the Effective Time, each share of Common Stock issued as of immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically subdivided and reclassified into ten (10) validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable shares of Common Stock. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on June 10, 2024.

D1.decision: Apply the mandatory ten-for-one split confirmed effective by the 2024-06-07 effectiveness filing, using the 2024-06-06 record-date position from the supporting announcement. Update today's PCF and confirm the post-split position using the effectiveness filing. Separately book the gross June dividend under the 2024-05-22 dividend announcement. No election is available or required. Hold only the withholding adjustment and net dividend cash figure pending the missing tax documentation.
